title: NavigationType
summary: The three browser history operation names.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: The union is "POP" | "PUSH" | "REPLACE". POP includes the initial entry and history traversal; PUSH adds an entry; REPLACE updates the current entry.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Read this through useNavigationType after the application navigation integration is installed. It is not the same as loading/submitting/idle request state.
